title: Mixing: I Found Out by John Lennon | 1970
content:
Studio Three, EMI Studios, Abbey Road
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono
Engineers: Phil McDonald, John Leckie

‘I Found Out’ was mixed for John Lennon’s debut solo album, John Lennon/Plastic Ono Band, on 10 October 1970.

The song had been recorded on 27 September, with overdubs on 7 October.

This day’s mixes of ‘I Found Out’ were not used, however, and final mixes were created on 24 October.

Later in the session, the first studio recordings for Yoko Ono’s album Yoko Ono/Plastic Ono Band were made.
